I can’t give an exact numeric value from that description alone — the chart has no data labels or source table, so an exact value isn’t available. Based on the axis ticks (0, 5, 10, 15) and your note that the West Q3 bar falls between 10 and 15, the only reliable statement is that West Q3 is > $10M and < $15M. Visually it looks roughly around $12–13M (approximate), but that is an estimate, not an exact measurement.

If you need the exact value, provide the underlying data or the chart’s source (spreadsheet, CSV, or the original chart file). If you can upload a high-resolution image of the chart I can give a tighter pixel-based estimate and explain the uncertainty.
